author: Katkov, George
title: Russia 1917, the Kornilov Affair: Kerensky and the Break-up of the Russian Army
notes: The case that Kerensky, not Kornilov, precipitated the crisis of late August, and that its real cost was the destruction of the army's command structure. A partisan book about a partisan quarrel; cited as one reading of a disputed episode. Borrow-only; cited without pages.
